I've saved this as a project convention in EngramDB, which is the memory store this project's CLAUDE.md says to use. From now on, all background jobs go through `jobs.enqueue()`, and Celery is never called directly (no `.delay()`, `.apply_async()` or `send_task()`). It will show up in future sessions whenever background-job work comes up.

The repo doesn't contain `jobs.enqueue()` or any Celery code yet. So there's nothing to migrate now, but the rule will apply as soon as that code exists.
